title: Ask for one field
summary: GraphQL: Ask for one field. Change the resolver greeting.
introduction: A schema names allowed fields. The resolver supplies a value for greeting.
learningObjectives: Ask for one field with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Ask for one field

blocks.text: The Query type declares greeting. The root resolver supplies its string when that field is selected.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A query can only ask for fields declared in the schema.
